company.name: Advanced Petrochemical
company.shortDescription: Advanced Petrochemical is a chemical company specializing in the production of propylene through PDH-Catifin Technology.
company.description: Advanced Petrochemical is committed to both the royal commission and the presidency of metrological and environmental protection in terms of environmental considerations such as ground and wastewater quality, sea discharges, and safety. The company also makes an effort to educate its employees in all aspects of life in order to raise awareness about safety, health, and the environment, which has an impact on performance and, as a result, raises the overall standard of the organization.
